heading_rule: Unchanged 3a60531 chord variant: first cumulative distance crossing 20mm; direct chord must also reach20mm; other initial adjacent segments >=20mm; freeze k throughout solve
worker: Existing /usr/bin/python3 with SciPy1.11.4; separate CPU process and background pipe thread
attempt_policy: At most one attempt per FRESH ID; next attempt uses most recent valid FRESH; no restart or tuning
trigger: After actual fixed dynamic spawn, valid nominal PD unsafe for16/72s
wait_policy: STOP until outstanding result resolved; VLA observations/inference continue
acceptance: Converged, same B within1e-9 per pose component, identical active geometry, freshly rechecked PD swept clearance>=.02m and corridor>0
graph_action: Separate fixed command action for at most16 ticks; recheck16tick safety at every9Hz refresh; cancel ifunsafe; then return to nominal controller
graph_action_priority: Accepted bounded Graph action finishes before returning to newest nominal waypoint; pending solve holds STOP even if newer nominal waypoint arrives
graph_age: Original receive timeout stays1s for nominalPD. Graph action may beolder; log input age and receive age separately; never label it a fresh waypoint switch
waypoint_semantics: core and events retain nominal IDs/commands; actual applied command and Graph action ID logged separately
invalid_heading: No solve; STOP and wait for a later valid FRESH
scope: Stop-and-plan kinematic closed loop, not real-time Graph or PhysX; nonpaired two single runs
